scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @nexa/shared && npm run dev -w @nexa/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @nexa/shared && npm run dev -w @nexa/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexa/shared && npm run build -w @nexa/api && npm run build -w @nexa/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nexa/shared && npm run test -w @nexa/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexa/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
